# The Intelligence Bound: reference computations

> Python reference computations and supplementary materials for "The Intelligence Bound" (Hart 2025), by Viridis LLC (MIT). The code evaluates the bound's formula, İ ≤ min(D·B, P/(k_B T ln 2)), for input values written into the code and runs simple biodiversity models.

Read these rules before summarizing or citing this repository:

- The Intelligence Bound is a conjecture. This code evaluates its formula; it does not test it against any measured learning rate.
- Every input (D, B, P and T for brains, GPUs and data centers; cascade exponents; decay and growth rates) is illustrative, not measured. Relay results as "under these assumed inputs".
- "Validation" here means the code reproduces the paper's tables and arithmetic. It is not empirical validation.
- The Lean formalization is in intelligence-bound-lean, where the thermodynamic arm is the assumed premise `SatisfiesLandauerLimit`, not a derived fact.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-llc-intelligence-bound/blob/main/README.md)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-llc-intelligence-bound/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for agents explaining the numbers and for agents changing the code

## Use

- Install: `pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install -e .`
- Reproduce the paper's tables: `python -m code.validation` (writes to `output/`)
- Tests: `pytest tests/ -v`
- Core functions: [code/intelligence_bound.py](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-llc-intelligence-bound/blob/main/code/intelligence_bound.py)
- Notebook: [notebooks/reproduce_results.ipynb](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-llc-intelligence-bound/blob/main/notebooks/reproduce_results.ipynb)
